title: Music City Bungalow- Private Parking Garage
description:
Just a 5 minute drive from downtown Nash, yet tucked away enough to truly relax. 

This thoughtfully designed space blends comfort and style, offering a calm escape that’s close to everything.

Step inside to an airy, open layout with abundant natural light, soft neutral tones, and curated touches that make the space feel both modern and cozy.

Whether you’re visiting for a weekend getaway, a work trip, or a longer stay, this bungalow offers the perfect balance of tranquility and convenience.

The space
Open layout—living room, kitchen, and king-sized bed all in one room.

Private garage with keypad entrance. Apartment is above garage. 

Kitchen includes refrigerator, freezer, stovetop, microwave & dishwasher.  NO oven.

Bathroom includes towels, washcloths, shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and hair dryer.

Washer & dryer in unit (downstairs in garage below apartment). Clothing steamer also provided in closet.

Guest access
This is a completely separate building from the main house.  You have a private entrance and your own personal garage to park in.  The apartment is above the garage where you park.

Other things to note
Due to all of the light colored furniture and bedding, we do not allow pets.
